canonical_project: Start Campus SINES DC / Sines 4.0 - SIN01 (NEST)
notes: Flagship hyperscale campus in ZILS Sines Industrial and Logistics Zone, Setubal district. Official Start Campus page cites 1.2 GW total campus secured capacity and 37.5 MW live first facility (SIN01); phase-1 construction began April 2022. DCD/ECO confirm SIN01 first building inaugurated; Nscale-Microsoft deployment of ~12,600 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs at SIN01 from Q1 2026 (TechCrunch). Campus design 1.2 GW; live 37.5 MW. Grade A- for operator page existence/capacity, B for operational status confirmation.
